title: Discovery of phenylacetamide derivatives as novel STAT3 antagonists.
journal: Medicinal chemistry research : an international journal for rapid communications on design and mechanisms of action of biologically active agents
one_liner_zh: 该文设计苯乙酰胺类STAT3拮抗剂，通过FP实验和分子对接研究其抑制STAT3二聚化与DNA结合，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但以药物发现为主，方法仅用简单对接，深度不足。
abstract: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) is a central transcription factor in the JAK-STAT signaling axis and is commonly considered to be an anti-cancer drug target. However, no inhibitors that directly target STAT3 have been approved for use in patients. Targeting STAT3 SH2 domain and DNA-binding domain remain the two principle strategies when developing STAT3 inhibitors. In this study, a series of compounds with a phenylacetamide core were designed, synthesized, and biologically evaluated. Two fluorescence polarization (FP) assays were used, where STAT3:DNA FP assay was to understand inhibition of STAT3 DNA-binding potential, whereas STAT3:phosphopeptide FP assay was to understand abrogation of STAT3 dimerization potential. The FP findings showed that the phenylacetamide derivatives were prone to inhibit STAT3 dimerization than STAT3 DNA-binding, showing selectivity over the STAT3 SH2 domain. Compounds P10, P15, and P21 showed potent STAT3 dimerization inhibition with FP-determined IC(50) values of ~15.6, ~29.4, ~6.49 muM respectively. Molecular docking results showed that compounds P10, P15, and P21 may bind between the Linker and SH2 domains, and they displayed potential hydrogen bonding in the binding pocket. Prediction results of drug-likeness and physiochemical property values warrant P10, P15, and P21 to be further investigated.
abstract_zh: 信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）是JAK-STAT信号轴中的核心转录因子，通常被视为抗癌药物靶点。然而，目前尚无直接靶向STAT3的抑制剂获批用于患者。靶向STAT3的SH2结构域和DNA结合结构域仍是开发STAT3抑制剂时的两大主要策略。在本研究中，设计、合成并生物学评价了一系列以苯乙酰胺为核心结构的化合物。采用两种荧光偏振（FP）测定方法，其中STAT3:DNA FP测定用于了解对STAT3 DNA结合潜力的抑制，而STAT3:磷酸化肽FP测定用于了解对STAT3二聚化潜力的消除。FP结果表明，苯乙酰胺衍生物倾向于抑制STAT3二聚化而非STAT3 DNA结合，显示出对STAT3 SH2结构域的选择性。化合物P10、P15和P21显示出有效的STAT3二聚化抑制作用，其FP测定的IC(50)值分别约为15.6、29.4和6.49 μM。分子对接结果显示，化合物P10、P15和P21可能结合于Linker和SH2结构域之间，并在结合口袋中显示出潜在的氢键作用。药物相似性和理化性质预测结果支持P10、P15和P21值得进一步研究。
